def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=comps(g,bg)
    # longest straight stroke color
    best=0; stroke_col=None
    for col,n,r0,c0,cells in objs:
        for (a,b) in cells:
            for da,db in ((0,1),(1,0)):
                L=1; x,y=a+da,b+db
                while (x,y) in set(cells) if False else (0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]==col):
                    L+=1; x+=da; y+=db
                if L>best: best=L; stroke_col=col
    # largest identical-shape pair
    byshape=defaultdict(list)
    for col,n,r0,c0,cells in objs: byshape[mask(cells)].append((col,r0,c0,cells))
    pairs=[v for v in byshape.values() if len(v)>1]
    if not pairs: return [row[:] for row in g]
    pair=max(pairs,key=lambda v:len(v[0][3]))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # lower member = larger r0
    tgt=max(pair,key=lambda v:v[1])
    for a,b in tgt[3]: out[a][b]=stroke_col
